scope: Both anonymous sources, Android and iOS, all P1/P2/H1 cases delivered in evaluation-inputs/final/T1. Approved design is the reference, never another candidate.
attributions: Empty: frozen recomputation found no native/pixel F and this review found no qualitative F. No missing-scope F was attributed.
native_limits: Seven iOS title-native-weight cells per case remain unsupported; 42 total are U. No font values or unsupported geometry were entered by this reviewer.
uncertainty: Both P1 iOS expanded sweeps miss the last 2.333333 native content units in the strict interval union; source-b iOS H1 submitted misses the last 5.666667. Both qualitative atoms in each of those three states remain null. Two additional target-only states also have incomplete full coverage (both P1 blocked and source-b H1 reselected are recorded individually in coverage).
disagreement: Not assessed: no other member output was read. The evaluator self-check supplied this same request in both judge slots; that is schema validation only and is not independent consensus or human gold.
contradictory_evidence_preserved: A side-by-side strip initially looked like adjacent P1 Android reason/detail text touched. The direct original source-a Android P1 snapshot 41 and original labeled contact page 3 show separated card text. No collision was asserted from the derivative display.
A footer and sentinel are visible in incomplete iOS sweeps. The strict original interval union remains incomplete, so visual true was withheld despite that positive fragment.
originals_and_hashes: input-hashes.json verifies all referenced original files exactly; inspection-records.json binds original paths and SHA256 to each selected state/index; no original files were modified.
